Questions

Pricing and payment FAQ.

Is the first call really free?

Yes. Every service starts with a free, no-obligation call to understand your goal, check the fit and agree on a plan.

How long is a session?

About an hour. Leadership and executive sessions typically run 60–75 minutes.

How long are packages valid?

Packages of 5 or 10 sessions stay valid for 3 months, and packages of 15, 20 or 25 sessions for 6 months, enough to use them at a steady pace, even with a busy month or a holiday in between.

How can I pay?

You choose: card via Stripe, PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Zelle (US bank accounts), crypto (stablecoins such as USDC) or a direct bank transfer. Payment details are sent with your invoice after the free intro call.

What if I need to cancel or reschedule?

Give at least 24 hours’ notice and you can move or cancel a session at no charge. Cancellations with less notice, and no-shows, are charged in full or count as a used package session. You can pause a package for up to 90 days. See the full cancellation policy.

Can my employer pay?

Yes. Receipts and invoices are available on request for employer reimbursement, and companies can book structured corporate programs.

What currency are prices in?

Prices are shown in euros first, with the US dollar price in brackets. Prices are set in dollars and converted at the latest European Central Bank reference rate, updated every working day. Euro amounts are rounded; your invoice shows the exact amount. The EUR/USD switch in the header shows dollars only.

Which service should I choose?

If an interview or career move is coming up, start with interview coaching. If your language and confidence at work are the main barrier, start with communication coaching. If you manage people or work with senior stakeholders, choose leadership coaching. You can always switch, and the intro call will help you decide.

Start with a free call. Decide after.
